key_catalyst: Rising Treasury Yields Pressure Growth Stock Valuations
reasoning: All five open catalysts have no news updates for three trading days (July 18-20), and the market has shown clear recovery with a +0.74% intraday gain on July 17 followed by a +1.26% pre-market bounce on July 20, suggesting the market is absorbing these risks.
